name: synchub
description: GitHub-first development traceability platform with projects, tasks, delivery history and resumable local infrastructure.

scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @synchub/contracts && npm run build -w @synchub/api && npm run build -w @synchub/web
scripts.check: npm run quality && npm run verify && npm run build -w @synchub/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @synchub/api && npm run typecheck -w @synchub/web
scripts.test: npm run test:source && npm run test -w @synchub/contracts && npm run test -w @synchub/api
